top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Nutritional Value (26 TAC §746.3309(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a signed statement that the operation is not responsible for nutritional value for child.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §747.2319(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children, age 14 and 19 months, were asleep with their bottles provided to them before nap time.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Individual was present in the operation with an ineligible background check.   CORRECTED when individual was removed from the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Facility Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §747.3203(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation was observed extremely warm, and not well ventilated with thermostat showing temperature of 81 degrees during inspection

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under two were watching television.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant in care did not have updated feeding instructions within the past thirty days.
